- **Photos found on the drive, as pictures (FL-1533):** Library care has a new page that shows the files that were on the drive but in nobody's library as a grid of photos, in four lists: Needs you, Put back, Added and Spare copies. Click a photo to see what happened to it, step by step. Another account's photo shows a lock, never its picture. In File checks, "Stray files" is now "Files not in a library", and it shows what became of the files with a "See the photos" button in place of a list of paths.
- **Undo, and decisions by the group (FL-1537):** a photo that was put back or added can be undone from its page, and its file stays on the drive. Files that need you are grouped so one decision covers them all: choose whose library a folder's photos go to, or add an account's photos over its storage limit this once. Spare copies can be deleted after the photo they copy is read again and opens. A file that is named like a photo but won't open is listed for you instead of being added.
- **Previews and XMP files are tidied by themselves (FL-1537):** previews for photos that are gone are cleared, and an XMP file beside a photo of the same name is joined to that photo. Neither is listed any more. Two new switches, both on: "Put found photos back by themselves" and "Clear previews for photos that are gone".
- **Looking for a missing photo's file is much lighter on the drives (FL-1534):** a search reads each file on the drive at most once and remembers what it read, so later searches and the nightly check don't read it again unless it changes. During the nightly scan there is one search at the end instead of a new one every couple of minutes. The full check that reads every original, which used to run in one go each week, is spread out: about one twenty-eighth of the library each night, so every original is still read once every four weeks.
- **Recognising people is faster (FL-1575):** four faces are recognised at once, without starting duplicate people.
- **Best Photos picks real photos (FL-53):** tiny solid-colour images are no longer chosen.
- **A Locked copy counts as a duplicate before upload (FL-1572):** a file whose copy is in Locked is caught before it is sent again in full.
- **Import your Lightroom and darktable edits (FL-956):** edits kept in XMP files are imported into Develop versions.
- **Clients: email campaigns (FL-1083):** send email campaigns from Clients, with opt-outs that are always kept.
- **Clients: guests find their photos with a selfie (FL-1059):** a guest can find themselves in a gallery from one selfie.
- **Clients fixes (FL-1536, FL-1570, FL-1571, FL-1574):** bulk gallery setup, status and invitation retries; intake credits kept while metadata is read; campaign upgrades in the right order; an old gallery render no longer blocks delivery.
- **WordPress (FL-1518):** import selected Frameleaf images into WordPress.
- **Desktop AI on Windows (FL-1535):** the graphics-card runtimes load on Windows (CUDA and OpenVINO), and faces run on CoreML on a Mac.
